chunks: So, wherefore do they not believe?
ai.seo_question: Why do people refuse to believe in God according to Surah Al-Infitar?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Infitar, this verse underscores the psychological and spiritual obstinacy of the disbelievers who, despite witnessing the cosmic signs of the Day of Judgment, remain deaf to the call of faith. Shia exegetes often interpret this as a reflection of *al-jahd* (effortful denial), where truth is rejected not due to lack of evidence, but due to willful arrogance and attachment to worldly status.
